snippet.title: Golf-Like: Aim, Commit, Live With It | Golf Roguelike (Free Demo on Steam)
snippet.description:
A ball, a hole, and 12 kilometres of sinking road between them.
18 cards, 7 regions, a leaderboard that only counts time.

🎮 Free demo on Steam, wishlist Golf-Like:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3292300/GolfLike/

Golf-Like is a golf roguelike on a 12 km road over the sea that sinks behind you. Drag to aim, steer the ball in the air, open chests, pick from 18 cards and reach the hole. Coming Q4 2026 on Windows, macOS and Linux.

#indiegame #roguelike #golf
